title: Creating 2d game maps
author: Disastrous-Ad-6431
selftext:
Im struggling with creating 2d game map. Actually my workflow is Codex \[high sol\] > pixelab cli > aseprite > godot.  
Actually trying to create first hub location that looks okay, but i was hoping for much more.  
Im starting to think that creating 3d game with meshy would be easier.  
Later i want to include procedural maps, what will be even harder imo.   
Any tips/ideas?

comments.author: lucasamirati
comments.body:
Minha ideia era a de construir um jrpg em pixel art usando essas mesmas ferramentas que descreveu. Passei algumas semanas pesquisando e não encontrei uma solução. 

Agora estou tentando meshy + Claude/codex + blender + unity. 

Também não cheguei em lugar nenhum com isso. Ter uma qualidade visual e um workflow e assets que realmente pertençam ao mesmo mundo tem sido o meu maior desafio. Mas seguimos

replies.author: Disastrous-Ad-6431
replies.body: Im considering moving to 3d also. With meshy+blender. But i also considering finalizing my whole system setup and go full in astra high to create all assets and hope will see great outcome

replies.author: lucasamirati
replies.body: Yeah, I personally find it hard to keep building more systems if I don't know how it's going to look on screen. But if it works for you, go for it!

replies.author: Disastrous-Ad-6431
replies.body: I found nice solution for now, completly free, you just need better gpu, if you text me i can share my workflow, and help a bit. But most of it figured Claude and GPT.
